单位: GuangZhou Janus Biotechnology Co., Itd. Floor 1, Buliding A, No.1121 Haibin Rd., Nansha, GuangZhou, 511458, China
通讯: Fangqiu Ji @ GuangZhou Janus Biotechnology Co., Itd. Floor 1, Buliding A, No.1121 Haibin Rd., Nansha, GuangZhou, 511458, China  |  Chunyu Zhang @ GuangZhou Janus Biotechnology Co., Itd. Floor 1, Buliding A, No.1121 Haibin Rd., Nansha, GuangZhou, 511458, China
相关性: 该论文研究了基于SLM的多孔牙种植体结构优化，结合力学测试和生物实验，对骨整合和应力匹配有直接参考价值。
边界: The paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed as-built surface roughness characterization.
动机· 利用SLM技术设计多孔种植体以促进骨整合并优化结构。
方法· 通过SLM制造试样，进行金相观察、拉伸测试及有限元静力分析。
结果· 提出了基于力学和生物学实验的种植体结构优化建议。
验证· 通过拉伸试验和生物实验验证力学与骨整合性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design a porous dental implant using SLM that induces bone cell growth and optimize its structure through mechanical and biological evaluation.
Method· SLM was used to fabricate samples; optical metallography and tensile tests were conducted, and a finite element model under static loads was created for mechanical analysis.
Result· Optimization suggestions for SLM-made implant structure were proposed based on experimental observations and mechanical analysis.
Validation· Validation was performed through mechanical tensile testing and biological experiments observing osseointegration.

Motivation· To design patient-specific bone implants that mimic the internal structure of bone to reduce stress shielding caused by mechanical mismatch.
Method· A topology optimization approach with perimeter control is used to constrain the solution space and generate complex bone-like internal architectures.
Result· The method successfully recovers intricate bone internal structures with natural curvatures and avoids excessive isolated islands.
Validation· The approach is demonstrated on three distinct bone regions under physiological loading, with numerical simulations only.

通讯: Ken Nahshon @ Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division, West Bethesda, MD 20817

边界: No surrogate model, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.
动机· 高维参数空间下高保真仿真的不确定性传播计算成本高，需高效方法。
方法· 利用拉丁化部分分层采样（LPSS）结合简化模型设计采样方案，再用于高保真模型。
结果· 成功应用于加筋板屈曲强度分析，降低了计算成本。

Motivation· Efficient uncertainty propagation for high-fidelity simulations with large parameter spaces remains computationally prohibitive.
Method· Proposes Latinized partially stratified sampling (LPSS) combined with a simplified model to design an efficient sampling strategy for high-fidelity models.
Result· Demonstrates the methodology on a stiffened plate buckling problem, reducing computational cost while maintaining accuracy.
Validation· Convergence results from the simplified model are used to validate the LPSS design for the high-fidelity simulation.

Motivation· To identify the optimal interference fit for the tibial component of the cementless Oxford Unicompartmental Knee Replacement by balancing push-in and pull-out forces.
Method· Push-in and pull-out forces were measured for six tibial components implanted in polyurethane foam blocks with interference ranging from 0.1 mm to 1.9 mm using a materials testing machine.

Result· Hydroxyapatite prostheses showed better cosmetic results but 20.8% fracture rate and uncertain osseointegration.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with radiographic assessment of bone fusion at prosthesis margins.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To differentiate subchondral insufficiency fracture from osteonecrosis using imaging features to reduce unnecessary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Two blinded radiologists evaluated X-ray and MRI findings of 104 femoral heads with histopathologically confirmed SIF or ON.
Result· Parallel low-signal bands on MRI were associated with SIF, while serpentine bands indicated ON; SIF was frequently misdiagnosed on X-ray.
Validation· Histopathology served as the gold standard for diagnosis.

Result· Significant improvements in hip function and quality of life scores were observed, with an excellent/good rate of 90.47% at 6 months.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with statistical analysis of patient-reported outcomes.

Motivation· To evaluate the accuracy of acetabular cup alignment and positioning using ACA navigation in primary THR.
Method· A prospective study of 43 patients (50 hips) comparing navigated cup inclination, anteversion, and size with postoperative CT and X-ray measurements.
Result· 90% of cups were within the Lewinnek safe zone, but significant differences were found between navigated and CT measurements.
Validation· Clinical validation using postoperative CT scans and plain radiographs.
